observations: Photos show multiple wooden pallets stacked in a room/warehouse setting.
Several pallets have the circular stamp/mark that appears to read “EPAL”.
Some pallets look dusty/used; no clear evidence of cracks or broken boards from these angles.
No clear count of how many pallets are included, and no clear pallet dimensions or type (e.g., 4-way/2-way) shown.

claims.evidence: The photos show wooden pallets stacked and used as a base for stacking.

claims.claim: It available for pickup only in Port Harcourt
claims.evidence: No location details are visible in the photos.

risks.risk: Quantity is unclear (how many pallets you will receive).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo showing the full stack(s) with a visible count or a video panning across and counting, or the seller stating exact number of pallets.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the worst-case smallest quantity you might be offered (since quantity is unknown).

risks.risk: Condition varies: possible broken stringers, loose boards, or damaged deck boards not visible from these angles.
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of all four corners and underside/stringers of at least 2–3 pallets (or a short video walking around one pallet showing the boards and nails).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used/possibly damaged pallets (not guaranteed perfect condition).

risks.risk: EPAL authenticity/grade is not guaranteed by photos alone (stamp could be present but pallet may not meet full EPAL specs).
risks.proof: Request a photo of the full pallet stamp/marking area and any additional identifiers (e.g., heat treatment marks) plus a close-up of the deck boards and construction details.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic used wooden pallets with EPAL stamp visible, not guaranteed EPAL-grade.

risks.risk: Pallet type/dimensions not confirmed (could be different sizes or 2-way vs 4-way), affecting fit for your use.
risks.proof: Request a tape-measure photo showing length x width x height of one pallet.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as standard unknown-size used pallets (worst-case for mismatch).

proof_requests: Exact number of pallets included (count) with a clear photo/video of the full stack(s).
Close-up photos of corners and underside/stringers for at least 2–3 pallets.
Tape-measure photo showing pallet dimensions (L x W x H).
Close-up of the EPAL stamp/marking area and any other identifiers on one pallet.
response.reason: The photos confirm wooden pallets (with EPAL-like stamps), but key pricing drivers are missing: exact quantity, pallet dimensions/type, and condition details (damage/underside). Without those, a safe worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
